name: GEYSERIN_ST_IDLE
meaning: SetState 0: idlePeriod timer, anim state 5, victim cleared; Update: -> 1 on timer or msg 0x2884 (inferred)

name: GEYSERIN_ST_ACTIVE
meaning: SetState 1: activePeriod, anim state 6; Update: back to 0 when the out-geyser is idle (inferred)

name: GEYSERIN_ST_SUCK
meaning: SetState 2: msg 0x31 to the victim, anim state 9; Update: pulls the victim in (inferred)

name: GEYSERIN_ST_TRANSIT
meaning: SetState 3: anim state 8, transit delay; Update: carries the victim to the out-geyser (inferred)

name: GEYSERIN_ST_CORKED
meaning: SetState 4: corkPeriod, anim state 7; Update: a Rock plugs it (inferred)
